title: 第1748章 溃败第1747章 法相紫雷天尊
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
嘭！
神凰法相庞大身躯上的巨蟒尽数断裂开来，前者瞬间脱困而出。
“哼，死瞎子，有些手段，不过……在这紫霄雷域当中，我才是真正的主宰！”
紫霄雷尊怒啸一声，雷霆巨人的身躯，开始迅速变大，很快它的头颅，就穿透了云层，一双紫色雷眼，更是宛如日月般庞大恐怖，阴冷的眼神，自上而下，俯视着比自己矮小很多的金甲天神和神凰法相。
“你们两个，可以留下遗言了！”
浑厚如雷鸣的声音，响彻整个虚空，回响之声，如闷雷般回荡不绝。
“法相的威力，可不是长得高大，就厉害的。”楚天铭见此，嘴角微微扬起，露出了一抹略带轻蔑的笑意。
“死瞎子，很快我就让你知道，什么是绝望了！”
紫霄雷尊怒喝一声，双手掐动法印，那紫雷巨人猛地抬起右腿，向着金甲天神踩了过去。
“来的正好！”
楚天铭冷哼一声，右手轻轻一拍眉心。
下一秒！
金甲天神的六道轮回眼当中，六个光斑疯狂闪烁起来。
“这双眼睛……你……你竟然拥有轮回血脉？”看到这一幕，那紫霄雷尊脸上竟是浮现出了一抹惊慌之色，就连那雷霆巨人的大脚都停顿在了半空当中。
“还好，虽然我的眼睛没了，但是金甲天神的眼睛还在，这样一来，我可以通过金甲天神来观察四周的情况。”
楚天铭深吸一口气，身形一闪，出现在了金甲天神的头上，然后抬头看向眼前高耸入云的恐怖巨人。
紫霄雷尊，现在该你说出最后的遗言了。”
“哼，死瞎子，就算你有六道轮回眼又能如何，你不过只是真仙境，想要打败我，可没有那么容易！”
紫霄雷尊怒喝一声，双手抬起，雷霆巨人停顿在半空当中的遮天脚掌，猛地向着金甲天神踩了过来。
“给我去死！”

巨大的脚掌，彷佛一座大山自上而下压来，试图将金甲天神踩成肉泥。
“天铭，小心！”
韩清雪脸色微微一变，急忙操控神凰法相，喷出了一道炽热火柱，轰向了那雷霆巨人的身躯，试图将其击退。
然而那炽热火柱轰在了雷霆巨人庞大身躯之上后，便是瞬间被一道道雷霆交织的铠甲抵挡了下来。
“怎么会这样？”
韩清雪娇躯一颤，绝美的脸庞露出了一抹不可置信的表情。
“哼，不必白费力气了，就凭你们，是不可能抵挡住我的雷霆法相！”
伴随着紫霄雷尊的狂笑，那巨大的脚掌，直接踩向了金甲天神。
那巨大的脚掌尚未落下，恐怖的压迫力，直接使得金甲天神身下的地面，出现了无数道恐怖裂纹。
“既然你这么想要找死，那就让你见识一下六道轮回眼的威力吧！”
楚天铭低喝一声，双手合十，金甲天神的右手紧握成拳，然后猛地向着那那巨大的脚掌撞了过去。
content_en:
Bang!
All the giant pythons on Divine Phoenix Dharma Appearance's huge body broke apart, and the former escaped instantly.
"Hmph, you blind man, you have some tricks, but...in this purple sky thunder field, I am the real master!"
Zixiao Lei Zun roared angrily, and the body of the thunder giant began to grow rapidly. Soon its head penetrated the clouds. Its pair of purple thunder eyes were as huge and terrifying as the sun and the moon. From top to bottom, its cold eyes looked down at the golden-armored god and the divine phoenix, who were much shorter than themselves.
"You two can leave your last words!"
A sound as thick as thunder resounded throughout the void, and the reverberating sound echoed endlessly like muffled thunder.
"The power of the Dharma does not come from being tall." Seeing this, Chu Tianming raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing a slightly contemptuous smile.
"You blind man, I'll let you know soon what despair is!"
Zixiao Lei Zun roared angrily, pinched the seal with both hands, and the purple thunder giant suddenly raised his right leg and stepped towards the golden-armored god.
"Just in time!"
Chu Tianming snorted coldly and patted his eyebrows lightly with his right hand.
The next second!
In the six-path samsara eyes of the golden-armored god, six spots of light flashed crazily.
"These eyes...you...you actually have the bloodline of reincarnation?" Seeing this scene, a look of panic appeared on the face of Zixiao Lei Zun, and even the big feet of the thunder giant stopped in mid-air.
"Fortunately, although my eyes are gone, the eyes of the Golden Armored God are still there. In this way, I can observe the surrounding situation through the Golden Armored God."
Chu Tianming took a deep breath, flashed, and appeared on the head of the golden-armored god. Then he looked up at the terrifying giant towering in front of him.
Zixiao Lei Zun, now it’s your turn to say your last words. "
"Hmph, you damn blind man, so what if you have the Six Paths of Samsara Eye? You are just a true fairy. It's not that easy to defeat me! "
Zixiao Lei Zun roared angrily, raised his hands, and the thunder giant's sky-covering feet paused in mid-air, and suddenly stepped towards the golden-armored god.
“Go to hell! "
The huge soles of the feet were like a mountain pressing down from top to bottom, trying to trample the golden-armored god into a pulp.
“Tian Ming, be careful! "
Han Qingxue's expression changed slightly, and she hurriedly controlled the Divine Phoenix Dharma, and sprayed out a pillar of blazing fire, blasting towards the body of the thunder giant, trying to repel it.
However, after the blazing pillar of fire hit the huge body of the Thunder Giant, it was instantly blocked by the armor intertwined with thunder.
"How could this happen? "
Han Qingxue's delicate body trembled, and her beautiful face showed an expression of disbelief.
"Hmph, there's no need to waste your efforts. It's impossible for you to withstand my thunderous form! "
Accompanied by Zixiao Lei Zun's wild laughter, the huge soles of his feet stepped directly on the golden-armored god.
Before the huge sole of the foot fell, the terrifying pressure directly caused countless terrifying cracks to appear on the ground under the golden-armored god.
"Since you want to die so much, let me show you the power of the Six Paths of Samsara Eye! "
Chu Tianming shouted low, clasped his hands together, and the golden-armored god's right hand clenched into a fist, and then he slammed into the huge sole of his foot.
